hello, boys and girls! welcome to my portrait shop of wonders. I've been lurking around the modding forums for a while now and I've been itching to put out some work of my own. I wanted to start with the portraits because it's a fairly straight forward job so it shouldn't be too complicated for a beginner like me. I plan on replacing all the portraits in the game, starting with the bachelors & bachelorettes.


these portraits differ quite a bit from the original ones so I understand that they may not fit everyone's tastes. however, I am definitely open to suggestions/ critique to improve them over the future.


[b]Installation instructions:[/b]

[list]
[*]Download the files from the link provided
[*]Extract the archive
[*]Navigate to Stardew Valley/Content/Portraits
[*]Make a backup of the contents of the folder
[*]Copy the provided files and overwrite the ones in the Portraits folder
[*]
[/list][img]http://i.imgur.com/d7G1Eu7.png[/img]

okay, that's it for now. thanks for browsing and I hope you'll enjoy using my work! cheers~
